You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Zance ba a mana adalci dan abin yafara isar mu wlh mun gaji ga petrol sai hawa yake wlh bashi da imani baya tausayin talakawan arewa me yake mna nan yaxo yayi mna kuka😭 azabe amma ga abin da zai saka mana dashi nan

output.original_text: Zance ba a mana adalci dan abin yafara isar mu wlh mun gaji ga petrol sai hawa yake wlh bashi da imani baya tausayin talakawan arewa me yake mna nan yaxo yayi mna kuka😭 azabe amma ga abin da zai saka mana dashi nan
output.joy: Taya murna kan abin da zai taimaka mana, amma ina fargaba da yadda ba a mana adalci, mun gaji da farashin man fetur!
output.sadness: Yana da matukar tausayi cewa ba a mana adalci, mun gaji da wahalar neman petrol. Shin me ya sa ba su tausayin talakawan arewa?
output.fear: Ina jin tsoro game da halin da muke ciki, ba a mana adalci, mun gaji da gaske, wannan ba ya yi kyau, kuma ina fargabar yaya abin zai kare!
output.anger: Wannan rashin adalci yana buga min jiki! Mun gaji da wahalar neman petrol, me zai jefa kami cikin kuka sai kawai mungode muku!
output.surprise: Na kasance cikin mamaki game da yadda ba a mana adalci! Mun yi gaji sosai, amma har yanzu ana ta rike mu kan wannan hali na wahala!
output.disgust: Wannan rashin adalci yana ba ni zarra! Mun gaji da yunwa da wahalar neman mai, ya kamata su ji tsoron aikin su!
